jobs.title: Praktikum im Finanzwesen | Finance and Accounting | eCommerce
jobs.description: Dein Praktikum bei PROFISHOP – Gestalte die Zukunft des eCommerce mit uns! Wir bei PROFISHOP lieben, was wir tun: Den digitalen Handel revolutionieren. Mit über 1,5 Millionen Produkten und innovativen Ideen gestalten wir eine Plattform, die Unternehmen genau das bietet, was sie brauchen – und zwar schnell, flexibel und zuverlässig. Doch was uns wirklich ausmacht, ist unser Team. Hier wird nicht nur gearbeitet, sondern auch gelernt, gelacht und gemeinsam Neues geschaffen. Unsere Kultur basiert auf Wertschätzung, Kreativität und Teamgeist – Werte, die uns vier Jahre in Folge zu einem Kununu-Top-Arbeitgeber gemacht haben. Als Praktikant:in bist Du ein wichtiger Teil dieser Erfolgsgeschichte. Egal ob Du tiefer ins Finanzwesen eintauchst, neue Prozesse mitgestaltest oder kreative Ideen einbringst: Bei uns bist Du mittendrin, statt nur dabei. Mit Deinem persönlichen Buddy und unserem unterstützenden Team hast Du alles, was Du brauchst, um Dein Praktikum zu einem echten Highlight zu machen. Aufgaben Hands-on Finance: Du unterstützt unsere Debitoren- und Kreditorenbuchhaltung – hier lernst Du, wie echte Finanzprozesse ablaufen. Rechnungskontrolle deluxe : Du prüfst Rechnungen und Lieferscheine auf Herz und Nieren – Präzision ist Deine Superkraft. Excel-Challenges : Du erstellst Analysen, Reports und Übersichten – so wird Excel für Dich zum Spielplatz. Controlling & Co. : Du analysierst Konten, unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Reports und bringst Licht in die Zahlenwelt. Globaler Touch : Unsere internationale Ausrichtung bietet Dir Einblicke in Finanzprozesse über Deutschlands Grenzen hinaus. Qualifikation Studium läuft? Läuft! Du studierst einen wirtschaftsnahen Studiengang und suchst ein Pflichtpraktikum (mindestens 3 Monate). Zahlen und Details sind Dein Ding: Ob Rechnungen, Tabellen oder Analysen – Du liebst es, den Durchblick zu behalten und erkennst Fehler, die anderen entgehen. Du behältst den Überblick – organisiert, verlässlich und immer einen Schritt voraus. Vert

jobs.description: Key Responsibilities OHSE Systems & Risk Management: Implement safety protocols, conduct routine inspections, execute Job Safety Analyses (JSA), and enforce permit-to-work systems across factory departments. Incident Investigation: Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for near-misses, accidents, and environmental incidents; manage corrective and preventive action tracking. Environmental & Sustainability: Monitor wastewater, waste management, emissions, and energy/water conservation projects to align with local regulations and ISO standards. Training & Drills: Coordinate safety inductions, toolbox talks, fire/emergency evacuation drills, and lead the Emergency Response Team (ERT) readiness. Audits & Compliance: Maintain OHSE recordkeeping, ensure statutory compliance with Indonesian regulations, and manage internal/external ISO audit findings. Key Qualifications Education: Bachelors Degree in Safety, Environmental Science/Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related field. Experience: 2 to 5+ years of OHSE experience within manufacturing operations (FMCG, food/beverage experience strongly preferred). Standards & Systems: Solid understanding of ISO 45001, ISO 14001, hazard management, RCA tools, and local Indonesian environmental/labor regulations. Certifications (Preferred): Professional OHSE certification, First Aid, Fire Safety, or Emergency Response certifications.

jobs.description: Job Description: Melaksanakan seluruh aktivitas finance, accounting, dan perpajakan. Melakukan pencatatan transaksi keuangan dilakukan secara akurat, tepat waktu, dan sesuai standar akuntansi yang berlaku. Menyusun dan mereview laporan keuangan secara rutin. Mengelola arus kas (cash flow), pengendalian biaya, serta perencanaan keuangan perusahaan. Bertanggung jawab atas perhitungan, pemotongan, penyetoran, dan pelaporan pajak, khususnya PPh 21, serta pajak lainnya (PPh 23, PPh 25/29, PPN). Membuat laporan SPT bulanan, PPn dan SPT Tahunan Badan Memahami terkait AP & AR Melakukan rekonsiliasi Bank Memastikan kepatuhan perusahaan terhadap peraturan perpajakan dan keuangan yang berlaku. Berkoordinasi dengan pihak eksternal seperti kantor pajak, auditor, konsultan pajak, dan bank. Mendukung proses audit internal maupun eksternal. Kualifikasi / Kriteria: Pendidikan minimal S1 Akuntansi, Keuangan, Ekonomi, atau Perpajakan. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun sebagai staff di bidang Finance, Accounting & Tax. Wajib memahami dan menguasai PPh 21, termasuk perhitungan, pelaporan, dan regulasi terbaru. Memahami dasar perpajakan lain seperti PPh 23, PPh Badan, dan PPN menjadi nilai tambah. Mampu menyusun dan menganalisis laporan keuangan. Terbiasa menggunakan software akuntansi (accurate, odoo, zahir), pajak (coretax) dan Microsoft Excel (pivot, vlookup, dll). Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan problem solving yang baik. Teliti, bertanggung jawab, dan mampu bekerja dengan target serta deadline. Bersedia ditempatkan di Pandaan, Pasuruan.

Kendali penuh atas waktu serta jadwal harian Anda sendiri. Akses penuh ke dukungan persiapan sertifikasi/lisensi, pelatihan intensif 1-on-1, serta kerangka kerja yang teruji untuk membantu Anda mencapai profitabilitas dengan cepat. YANG AKAN ANDA LAKUKAN: Secara aktif membangun jejaring (networking), mencari prospek baru, dan menjalin hubungan konsultatif baik di komunitas lokal maupun digital. Melakukan sesi konsultasi mendalam untuk menganalisis dan mendiagnosis potensi risiko keuangan yang dihadapi klien. Menyusun dan mempresentasikan solusi proteksi (asuransi) serta mitigasi risiko yang disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan klien ritel maupun komersial. Menjaga dan membina hubungan baik dengan basis klien secara berkelanjutan demi meningkatkan pendapatan pasif (residual income) tahunan Anda. KANDIDAT IDEAL: Memiliki motivasi yang kuat untuk mencapai target (hunter mentality) serta kecerdasan emosional (EQ) yang tinggi. Berpengalaman di bidang yang berinteraksi langsung dengan klien, layanan pelanggan premium (high-end customer service), memiliki latar belakang kompetitif, atau berpengalaman sebagai mitra independen. Memandang penolakan bukan sebagai hambatan, melainkan sebagai bagian dari proses menuju "Ya" berikutnya. Memiliki komitmen penuh untuk belajar dan mengikuti sertifikasi/lisensi industri asuransi resmi (seluruh materi dan dukungan belajar akan disediakan).

jobs.description: About Aspora People on the move deserve a bank that moves with them. Since 2022, Aspora has been building a borderless financial operating system that makes money as mobile and transparent as its users. Backed by influential venture capitalists like Sequoia Capital, Greylock Partners, Hummingbird Ventures, Y Combinator & Global Founders Capital. We're a team of 150+ across India, the UK, the UAE, EU and the US, working with extreme ownership, radical candour, and an obsession with customer impact. We celebrate builders who question assumptions, ship fast, and turn regulatory complexity into elegant solutions. If you’re driven to redefine what global banking can be, we’d love to build the future with you. About the Role People build lives across borders, and their money should move with them. Every product, corridor and payment rail we add opens a new door for fraudsters. We want to be the least attractive target on our corridors, without adding friction for good customers. This role exists to own how we detect and deter fraud across every rail and geo. You’ll lead fraud detection and deterrence end to end, from exposure mapping to rules, limits and customer protection. You report to our Head of Financial Crime and work alongside the fraud recovery and chargebacks lead. You partner with Product, Payments, Engineering, Customer Support and Compliance on every launch. You decide what ships on day one, and you own the trade-off between fraud caught and friction added. Who You Are You don’t see fraud as a dashboard to watch. You see it as a live contest, won or lost in seconds, and you’ve been in it. You’ve done multiple rodeos. You’ve worked fraud at more than one fintech or high-velocity regulated platform across the UK, EU or US. That could be a neobank, payments company, gambling operator, gaming platform or crypto exchange. You know how attacks, rails and rules differ in each. You’ve built controls from scratch. jobs.description: Job Description The job of Accounting Associate is established for the purpose of supplying administrative support to Vessel Accountants being in the Philippines by performing clerical tasks such as preparing voucher documentation, filing, document balances as part of closing routines, basic bookkeeping, paying vendors, invoice customers, posting of invoices and other ad hoc tasks. Main Tasks: Prepare, review, and maintain accounting vouchers and supporting workpapers as the basis for general ledger entries, ensuring completeness, accuracy, proper accounting treatment, and compliance with internal control requirements and company policies. Maintain and oversee the organization of financial records and supporting documentation, ensuring proper documentation, accessibility, retention, and compliance with established records management and audit requirements. Perform quarterly balance sheet account reconciliation activities across assigned entities, including analysis of account movements, identification of aged or unusual items, investigation of variances, and timely resolution or escalation of reconciling items. Perform end-to-end bookkeeping and accounting activities for assigned entities, ensuring accurate, complete, and timely recording of financial transactions and appropriate recognition of costs in accordance with accounting policies. Monitor and manage the vendor invoice lifecycle, including follow-up on outstanding invoices, resolution of invoice-related issues, coordination with vendors and internal stakeholders, and timely processing to support accurate period-end closing and payment. Prepare and process customer billing and invoices, ensuring appropriate supporting documentation, accurate accounting information, adherence to contractual requirements, and compliance with internal controls and billing procedures.
